scope: Public Telegram channels for global humanitarian, political-violence, conflict, and OSINT situational awareness.

policy.activation_rule: Only channels with a directly verified public t.me page, clear public-interest relevance, and documented source identity may be enabled.
policy.evidence_rule: Every Telegram post is a lead, not a verified event. Preserve the original post URL and corroborate independently.
excluded_content: real-time tactical targeting or granular live military movement feeds
channels promoting violence or providing operational instructions
policy.bias_review: Record whether a source is independent, state-affiliated, partisan, advocacy-based, or unclear. Subscriber count is not credibility.

enabled_sources.name: Bellingcat EN
enabled_sources.assessment: Specialist investigative OSINT publisher; strong for investigations and verification methods, not a comprehensive breaking-news feed.

enabled_sources.name: BNO News
enabled_sources.assessment: Broad breaking-news coverage; use as an early lead and corroborate with primary sources and independent reporting.

enabled_sources.name: bdnews24.com
enabled_sources.assessment: Established Bangladeshi news publisher. Public preview showed an owner-inactivity warning; verify collector access and current posting cadence.

enabled_sources.name: Prothom Alo
enabled_sources.assessment: Public Telegram channel identifying itself as Prothom Alo's official channel.

enabled_sources.name: Rumor Scanner
enabled_sources.assessment: Public channel identifies itself as a Bangladeshi independent fact-checking initiative. Treat individual fact-checks as sourced claims and inspect their cited evidence.

enabled_sources.name: The Daily Star
enabled_sources.assessment: Public Telegram channel for The Daily Star Bangladesh.

review_queue.name: OSINTdefender
review_queue.reason: Public page confirmed, but coverage can include granular military and weapons information. Not enabled for automated ingestion.

review_queue.name: Molfar
review_queue.reason: Surfaced in a third-party catalogue; direct identity and current public access require confirmation.

discovery_references.name: TGScope OSINT Telegram catalogue
discovery_references.note: Third-party discovery catalogue; reported 88 public channels in its October 2026 OSINT hub. Not a verified whitelist.

discovery_references.name: WorldMonitor Telegram feed documentation
discovery_references.note: Documents a 56-channel feed including official, state-affiliated, partisan, and belligerent-party sources. Do not copy indiscriminately.
